title: Qianwen Creation Launches 7-Day Membership: 200 Points + Fast Track Targeting Immediate Creation Such as Travel Photography
excerpt: Qwen Create officially launches a 7-day membership service, targeting immediate and lightweight AI creation needs such as travel photography, event marketing, a
content_html:
Qwen Create officially launches a 7-day membership service, targeting immediate and lightweight AI creation needs such as travel photography, event marketing, and social media content creation. After purchasing, users will receive 200 points, exclusive fast generation channels, and priority access to new models and features.

Short-term Period Lowers the Trial Barrier

Compared to monthly subscriptions, the 7-day membership significantly lowers the user's trial and decision-making barriers with a shorter usage cycle. For users who only want to use AI to generate images or write copy during a trip, an event, or a social media campaign, they don't need to pay for long-term subscriptions, yet can still unlock core benefits such as fast generation and early experience of new features.

Currently, users can enter the membership center through the Qwen Create App or Web version, select "7-day Membership" and complete the subscription to unlock the corresponding benefits. From a product perspective, Qwen Create is making its membership system more flexible: using low-cost, short-term periods to accommodate lightweight "use-and-go" needs, while guiding frequent and heavy users toward longer-term subscriptions. The strategy of tiered operations is quite clear.
